result:
The review of i39's branch is done, with concerns: one problem needs fixing now, and one check couldn't be verified. w202, i39's only work-item, is fine.

**Fix now (Important, data lost).** i41's w204 added code to `scripts/supervise_change.py` (lines 91–99) that overwrites the lists of every proposal an integrate round's change list names, not just the proposal being re-drafted. When work-queue's integrate round 5 ran (commit `2862e7bf`), it named requests too, so it replaced the lists in `.shop/work/i39/requests.md`:
- adds went from r25, r28–r34, r39–r45 to r46, r47;
- removes went from r1, r3 to r13, r14.

The old lists named lines already applied to `spec/` and turned into scenarios. Two consequences:
- Work-items are drafted from a proposal's adds, so those lines would never get a work-item.
- The test run that marks unfinished scenarios as expected failures no longer covers 14 of the requests scenarios, so they now fail in every work-item's run.

The fix is to restore the lists from commit `64890ad5` and make that code merge lists into other proposals rather than replace them.

**Tests**
- Full suite at `d3079697`: 955 passed, 16 failed in 28.66 s. All 16 are scenarios written for lines that have no work-item yet. It runs in parallel and starts `scripts/work` as a separate process for each scenario.
- With expected failures marked (`--work-item w202 --whole-suite`): 14 failed, 955 passed, 2 expected failures. The 14 are the requests scenarios from the problem above.
- w202's own check: 145 passed, 1 skipped.

**w202 itself**
- It changes nothing under `features/`, removes or weakens no test, and adds no code that no requirement asks for.
- The test-change sections of its two reports say "none", and the commits agree.

**Could not verify:** whether a real integrate round can read the upstream's spec at a path outside its worktree. Only a real `claude -p` session would show that, and I don't start one. I also couldn't run my probe of the `## Upstreams` reader (approval was refused), so its edge cases are judged from reading the code.

**Other checks**
- Lint: 16 ruff errors, none in w202's files. Some are in w204's code, the rest in helper scripts that i39's and i41's rounds committed under `.shop/work/`. Dead-code check is clean; the project states no import contracts.
- No file is over 300 lines, and every feature binding names a scenario.
- These are logged as Minor observations, along with the hand-made commits that belong to no work-item.
